mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls growth above 0.3 percentage points signals stronger labor demand, which raises earnings expectations and boosts S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of accelerating payrolls (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Housing Starts Index below its 12-month moving average signals weakening residential demand, which reduces construction-related earnings and drags S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 12-month moving average for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below its 12-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and lowers S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 12-month moving average for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising rates above 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals labor market overheating, which raises wage inflation and reduces corporate margins, lowering S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling unemployment below 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Income above 0.5% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces retail sales and earnings, lowering S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling real personal income (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the Consumer Price Index above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, lowering S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising CPI above 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05).
